description: Order-based speech-to-speech voice conversion on the Voice Marketplace API: upload a recording and convert it to marketplace voices and accents, with optional pitch calibration and semitone correction.

meta.audio_formats_note: Accepted input formats for uploaded recordings.
meta.calibration: POST /api/calibration measures the speaker's mean pitch for better conversion; automatic calibration otherwise.

capability_notes.voice_cloning: converts recordings into a target marketplace voice/accent

meta.kind: voice conversion (audio in, converted audio out); not a conversational realtime model
meta.model_id_note: No model parameter: POST /api/recordings then POST /api/v2/orders with voice_id (+ optional accent_id). 'marketplace-sts' is a catalog label.

name: Respeecher Voice Marketplace Speech-to-Speech

pricing.notes: Pay-as-you-go credits: 1 credit = $1 = 1 minute of STS at list price; larger packs discounted up to 50% (500 credits for $250). Subscriptions: Creator $89/month (90 min STS + 400k characters); Power $499/month (900 min STS + 3M characters).

recommended_for: converting recorded speech to another voice

description: Respeecher Space low-latency text-to-speech model with Arabic as its primary language, served from its own base URL over HTTP bytes, SSE and WebSocket.

meta.concurrency: 5 concurrent generations per account (1 on free trial).
meta.max_text_chars_note: About 5,000 characters per Bytes request (120 s timeout, 100 MB response cap); use SSE/WebSocket for longer text.
meta.sampling_params: Per-voice sampling parameters (temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, penalties, seed) can be overridden per request.
meta.secondary_languages: Each model has some support for other languages for short passages within primary-language text.

name: Respeecher Space Real-Time TTS (Arabic)

pricing.notes: All voices $2 per 60,000 characters (roughly $2 per hour); custom pricing for high volume.

description: Order-based text-to-speech on the Voice Marketplace API: synthesise a text recording, then order conversions to marketplace voices with a narration style and download the results.

meta.daily_tts_request_limits: Plan dependent (e.g. 200 per day on the 16-credit pack).
meta.model_id_note: No model parameter: POST /api/v2/recordings/tts then POST /api/v2/orders with voice_id + narration_style_id. 'marketplace-tts' is a catalog label.

pricing.notes: Pay-as-you-go credits: 5 credits = $5 = 20k TTS characters (1 credit ≈ 4,000 characters); larger packs discounted up to 50% (500 credits for $250 = 2M characters). Subscriptions: TTS only $18/month; Creator $89/month (400k characters + 90 min STS); Power $499/month (3M characters + 900 min STS).
